title: Character Log
description: YAML frontmatter of a character log with an "already_claimed" HTTP response.

avatar_url.description: The character's resolved avatar image URL.

seen.description: "{TerritoryName}@{CurrentWorldName}" - the zone and world the character was last seen in.

utc.description: UTC instant the character was last seen.

level.description: The character's current level for the class/job.

fc_name.description: The character's Free Company's full display name (optional).

fc_lodestone_id.description: The character's Free Company's Lodestone ID (optional).

transfers.description: Comma-separated list of known Home World Transfer Service uses (optional).
